description.narrative: The Project is an equity investment of up to US$100 million, in Philippine peso equivalent, in Maynilad Water Services, Inc. (Maynilad, or the Company). The investment is part of Maynilad's initial public offering (IPO) on the Main Board of the Philippine Stock Exchange. The IPO proceeds will be used for the Company's water and wastewater capital expenditure program for FY25-27 (the Project).

The Project is expected to result in (i) improved water supply and quality for end-users, through increased water and wastewater treatment capacity, (ii) job creation during the construction period, and (iii) enhanced resilience to climate risks and emissions mitigation. Beyond the Project, the investment contributes to market resilience by demonstrating scalable solutions to the sustainable management of residential water and building resilience against hydrology risks amid high vulnerability to droughts.
